description: Source code for speed density fuel calculation in engine control software, including functions for temperature correction, air mass calculation, and fuel injection timing.

methods.name: getTCharge
methods.description: Calculates the charge temperature based on RPM, TPS, coolant and air temperature, with different modes for air interpolation or RPM/TPS interpolation.

methods.name: getCycleAirMass
methods.description: Calculates air mass in grams per cycle based on volumetric efficiency, manifold absolute pressure, and temperature.

methods.name: sdMath
methods.description: Calculates per-cylinder injection time in seconds based on air mass and target AFR.

methods.name: getSpeedDensityFuel
methods.description: Calculates per-cylinder fuel injection time in milliseconds based on MAP and engine state.

methods.name: setDefaultVETable
methods.description: Initializes VE and AFR tables with default values.

methods.name: initSpeedDensity
methods.description: Initializes speed density tables and maps.
